video.js 8.17.3
https://videojs.com

The two files in this folder are copied unmodified from the official
npm package (video.js@8.17.3, dist/):

  video.min.js
  video-js.min.css

License: Apache-2.0
https://github.com/videojs/video.js/blob/main/LICENSE

They are vendored so Hostaka does not depend on a third-party CDN.
The icon font is embedded inside video-js.min.css as a data URI.
